profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company traded under the ticker DXC, headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with SEC CIK 0001688568. The website text harvested for it, at dexus.com, describes Dexus, an Australasian infrastructure and real estate fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. That text does not describe DXC Technology Co, and it does not describe any AI business.

As the site presents it, Dexus describes itself as managing a multi-billion dollar portfolio and as combining local insight with world class expertise to unlock the potential of infrastructure and real estate for long-term value. The same text notes Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching its full height of more than 180 metres, which it calls the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, and a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. It carries disclaimers that the information may change without notice and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The held facts record no AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for the company. Virginia appears as a jurisdiction of law exposure with a count of 129.
